title: Round-2 Best Candidate Restart with 50nm Minimum Thickness Floor
scientific_hypothesis: The score degradation from Round 2 to Round 4 was caused by optimization exploring thickness values below 50nm where TMM numerical precision degrades. Restarting from the Round 2 optimum (score 0.9829) with a hard d>=50nm lower bound will recover or exceed the historical best performance.
design_principle: Preserve the verified high-performing thickness configuration from Round 2 while constraining the search space to numerically stable regions. The 50nm floor prevents thin-layer numerical collapse while allowing sufficient design freedom for refinement.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: Air | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | TiO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica. Total finite layers: 24.
manufacturing_considerations: TiO2/SiO2 material pair well-established for visible-NIR coatings
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack initialization provides physically motivated starting point for local optimization
Minimum thickness constraints prevent TMM numerical instability in thin-film regimes
known_risks: 50nm floor may exclude some optimal thin-layer configurations
Local optimization may converge to nearby suboptimal minimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degrees incidence. Initialize thicknesses from Round 2 best candidate: [45.47, 66.26, 100.01, 115.66, 54.39, 104.87, 69.43, 114.90, 69.98, 102.33, 64.45, 116.99, 56.99, 108.17, 51.15, 83.29, 45.85, 81.30, 51.66, 104.20, 56.85, 92.37, 39.98, 156.38] nm. Apply hard lower bound of 50nm to all layers (clip any thickness below 50nm to 50nm before optimization). Upper bound 200nm. Optimize for high reflectance in 450-650nm and high transmittance in 700-1000nm using gradient-based thickness optimization. Evaluate unpolarized light. Maximum 24 layers fixed. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Restart from Round 2 best state (score 0.9829) with 50nm minimum thickness constraint to address numerical instability suspected in Rounds 3-4 degradation. Differs from prior iterations by enforcing thickness floor and reinitializing from historical optimum rather than continuing degraded trajectory.
